verdict.rationale: The only scale-related evidence is the Orama Cloud tagline "Run Orama at scale. Managed." (orama-probe-1) and an on-premise Orama Cloud deployment option (orama-docs-8). Together these imply a managed scaling path, but no mechanics are documented. insertMultiple guidance addresses event-loop blocking during bulk inserts, not cluster scale. missing for 10: documented clustering/sharding, replication, high-availability/failover configuration, any stated capacity or benchmarks toward hundreds of millions of documents, and independent corroboration of large-scale operation.
